cfa_description: AI summaries and display aliases for Manage Chat Files. Data is stored in browser IndexedDB by default.
cfa_provider_current: Current SillyTavern API and preset (independent background request)
cfa_current_generation_preset: Custom APIs still use the currently selected Dialogue Completion generation preset. API keys are stored by the SillyTavern server.
cfa_show_user_name: Show this chat's {{user}} name in display aliases
cfa_auto_summary_interval: Refresh after this many new message layers
cfa_auto_summary_help: Default: every 10 new layers, about 5 user/AI exchanges. Automatic generation may incur API charges.
cfa_concurrent_help: Default: 3. Additional summaries wait in a queue. This only limits the extension's extra requests and does not block normal SillyTavern chat generation.
cfa_context_recent: Send the latest X message layers
cfa_context_help: Recent mode counts non-system messages; system messages inside the selected range remain untrusted data.
cfa_storage_default: Summaries and aliases are stored in this browser's IndexedDB by default. Chat JSONL files are not modified.
cfa_write_chat_files: Also write plugin data into each chat file
cfa_write_warning: Embedded data follows exports and backups, but saving rewrites the JSONL. Enabling this does not rewrite old chats automatically.
cfa_embed_existing: Write the current open chat's local data to its chat file
cfa_rebuild_index: Rebuild this character/group's local index from chat files
cfa_clear_embedded: Remove embedded data from the current open chat
